paragraphs.source_en: I am a cat. As for a name, I have none as yet.

units.source_en: I am a cat.
units.source_zh: 我是只猫儿。

units.source_en: As for a name, I have none as yet.
units.source_zh: 要说名字嘛，至今还没有。

paragraphs.source_zh: 我是只猫儿。要说名字嘛，至今还没有。

paragraphs.source_en: Where I was born, I have never been able to make out. All I remember is that in some dim, damp place I was mewing away, and there for the first time I beheld that strange creature called a human being. Moreover, I later heard that the first human I saw was a student, the most savage and brutal breed among mankind. They say students of this sort often catch us, boil us, and eat us. At the time, however, I was still too ignorant to know fear; when he set me on his palm and whisked me up into the air, I merely felt a little light and giddy. After I had settled down a little on the student's palm, I saw his face. That, I suppose, was my first sight in all my life of what is called a human being. At the time I thought, "What a curious thing a human is!" That impression remains deeply fixed in my memory even today. To begin with, the face, which ought to have been adorned with fur, was smooth and bare, just like a round copper kettle for boiling water. I have met many cats since, but never once have I encountered one maimed to such a degree. Not only that: from the dark hole protruding high in the middle of his face, smoke kept puffing out now and then, choking me until I could hardly bear it. Only recently did I learn that the thing was the tobacco humans smoke.

units.source_en: Where I was born, I have never been able to make out.
units.source_zh: 我出生在哪里，自己一直搞不清楚。

units.source_en: All I remember is that in some dim, damp place I was mewing away, and there for the first time I beheld that strange creature called a human being.
units.source_zh: 只记得好像在一个昏黑、潮湿的地方，我曾经“喵喵”的哭叫来着，在那儿第一次看见了人这种怪物。

units.source_en: Moreover, I later heard that the first human I saw was a student, the most savage and brutal breed among mankind.
units.source_zh: 而且后来听说，我第一次看见的那个人是个“书生”，是人类当中最凶恶粗暴的一种人。

units.source_en: They say students of this sort often catch us, boil us, and eat us.
units.source_zh: 据说就是这类书生时常把我们抓来煮着吃。

units.source_en: At the time, however, I was still too ignorant to know fear; when he set me on his palm and whisked me up into the air, I merely felt a little light and giddy.

ja.t: じがあったばかりである。

units.source_zh: 不过，当时我还不懂事，所以并不懂得什么是可怕，只是当他把我放在掌心上，嗖的一下举起来的时候，我有点悠悠忽忽的感觉罢了。

units.source_en: After I had settled down a little on the student's palm, I saw his face.
units.source_zh: 我在书生的掌心上，稍稍镇静之后，便看见了他的面孔。

units.source_en: That, I suppose, was my first sight in all my life of what is called a human being.
units.source_zh: 这恐怕就是我有生以来第一遭见到的所谓人类。

units.source_en: At the time I thought, "What a curious thing a human is!"
units.source_zh: 当时我想：“人真是个奇妙之物！”

units.source_en: That impression remains deeply fixed in my memory even today.
units.source_zh: 直到今天这种感觉仍然深深地留在我的记忆中。

units.source_en: To begin with, the face, which ought to have been adorned with fur, was smooth and bare, just like a round copper kettle for boiling water.

ja.t: がつるつるして、まるで

units.source_zh: 甭说别的，就说那张应当长着茸毛的脸上，竟然光溜溜的，简直像个烧水的圆铜壶。

units.source_en: I have met many cats since, but never once have I encountered one maimed to such a degree.
units.source_zh: 我在后来也遇到过不少的猫，可是不曾见过有哪一只残废到如此的程度。

units.source_en: Not only that: from the dark hole protruding high in the middle of his face, smoke kept puffing out now and then, choking me until I could hardly bear it.

ja.t: している。そうしてその

units.source_zh: 不仅如此，面部中央高高突起的黑洞洞里还不时地喷出烟雾来，呛得我实在受不了。

units.source_en: Only recently did I learn that the thing was the tobacco humans smoke.
units.source_zh: 最近我才知道那玩意儿就是人类抽的烟。

paragraphs.source_zh: 我出生在哪里，自己一直搞不清楚。只记得好像在一个昏黑、潮湿的地方，我曾经“喵喵”的哭叫来着，在那儿第一次看见了人这种怪物。而且后来听说，我第一次看见的那个人是个“书生”，是人类当中最凶恶粗暴的一种人。据说就是这类书生时常把我们抓来煮着吃。不过，当时我还不懂事，所以并不懂得什么是可怕，只是当他把我放在掌心上，嗖的一下举起来的时候，我有点悠悠忽忽的感觉罢了。我在书生的掌心上，稍稍镇静之后，便看见了他的面孔。这恐怕就是我有生以来第一遭见到的所谓人类。当时我想：“人真是个奇妙之物！”直到今天这种感觉仍然深深地留在我的记忆中。甭说别的，就说那张应当长着茸毛的脸上，竟然光溜溜的，简直像个烧水的圆铜壶。我在后来也遇到过不少的猫，可是不曾见过有哪一只残废到如此的程度。不仅如此，面部中央高高突起的黑洞洞里还不时地喷出烟雾来，呛得我实在受不了。最近我才知道那玩意儿就是人类抽的烟。

paragraphs.source_en: For a while I sat quite comfortably in the student's palm, but before long I grew dizzy and my chest began to feel sick. Whether the student was turning or I myself was turning, I could not tell; I thought my end had surely come. At last there came a heavy thud, and sparks immediately burst before my eyes. My memory ends there; what happened afterward I cannot recall no matter how hard I try.

units.source_en: For a while I sat quite comfortably in the student's palm, but before long I grew dizzy and my chest began to feel sick.

ja.t: っておったが、しばらくすると

units.source_zh: 我在书生的掌心里舒舒服服地坐了一会儿，可是没过多久，我便觉得头晕眼花，胸口难受。

units.source_en: Whether the student was turning or I myself was turning, I could not tell; I thought my end had surely come.
units.source_zh: 我不知道这是书生在转动呢，还是我自己在转动，心想这下子准没命啦。

units.source_en: At last there came a heavy thud, and sparks immediately burst before my eyes.
units.source_zh: 最后只听见“咚”的一声响，我两眼立刻冒出了金星。

units.source_en: My memory ends there; what happened afterward I cannot recall no matter how hard I try.
units.source_zh: 我的记忆就到此为止，再往后究竟出了什么事，我无论如何也回忆不起来了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 我在书生的掌心里舒舒服服地坐了一会儿，可是没过多久，我便觉得头晕眼花，胸口难受。我不知道这是书生在转动呢，还是我自己在转动，心想这下子准没命啦。最后只听见“咚”的一声响，我两眼立刻冒出了金星。我的记忆就到此为止，再往后究竟出了什么事，我无论如何也回忆不起来了。

paragraphs.source_en: Then, when I suddenly came to, the student was gone, not one of my many brothers and sisters was in sight, and even my dearly beloved mother had vanished to I knew not where. Besides, unlike the place where I had been before, this place was extraordinarily bright, so bright I could scarcely keep my eyes open. I thought, "How strange. What on earth has happened?" So I tried slowly crawling a few steps, only to feel my whole body aching terribly. It turned out that I had been suddenly thrown from my straw nest into a clump of low bamboo grass.

units.source_en: Then, when I suddenly came to, the student was gone, not one of my many brothers and sisters was in sight, and even my dearly beloved mother had vanished to I knew not where.

ja.t: はいない。たくさんおった

units.source_zh: 随后，我突然清醒过来，那个书生已经不见了，原先那么多兄弟姐妹也一个看不见了，就连我那最最亲爱的妈妈也去向不明。

units.source_en: Besides, unlike the place where I had been before, this place was extraordinarily bright, so bright I could scarcely keep my eyes open.

ja.t: いていられぬくらいだ。

units.source_zh: 而且，这里和我早先呆的地方不同，亮得出奇，几乎令人睁不开眼睛。

units.source_en: I thought, "How strange. What on earth has happened?"
units.source_zh: 我想：“真奇怪，这是怎么回事呢？”

units.source_en: So I tried slowly crawling a few steps, only to feel my whole body aching terribly.
units.source_zh: 于是我试着慢慢爬了几步，只感到浑身疼得要命。

units.source_en: It turned out that I had been suddenly thrown from my straw nest into a clump of low bamboo grass.
units.source_zh: 原来我是从稻草窝里一下子被丢进了矮竹丛里。

paragraphs.source_zh: 随后，我突然清醒过来，那个书生已经不见了，原先那么多兄弟姐妹也一个看不见了，就连我那最最亲爱的妈妈也去向不明。而且，这里和我早先呆的地方不同，亮得出奇，几乎令人睁不开眼睛。我想：“真奇怪，这是怎么回事呢？”于是我试着慢慢爬了几步，只感到浑身疼得要命。原来我是从稻草窝里一下子被丢进了矮竹丛里。
